_comment: The v5r pack's own settings defaults. Pure data on purpose: the plugin must fold these UNDER the user's settings BEFORE the kernel is constructed, and a synchronous JSON read is the only way to do that from a plugin whose top level cannot await. Every key must exist in settings/schema.js; the gate can check that, because a default for an undeclared key is a typo that would otherwise fail silently.
_round2: ROUND 2 (D-08): the v5r INSTITUTION's preferences for the new primitives (chat / mailbox / panel / resume / human / math jobs). These are STRATEGY, not mechanism: the kernel primitives read them and enforce; the pack only says what this institution wants. Values are grounded in _handoff/vmu/v5r-inventory-c.md (chat/panel/meeting) and inventory-a (resume). The reporting policy is NOT here: it is declared on the loaded manifest (packs/v5r/prompts/v5r-core.js) and applied by the pack loader - a key declared in both places would be refused as a conflict (O4).
_round7: ROUND 7 fidelity audit (Lead ruling): `vmu.math.maxParallel` below is a RESTATEMENT OF THE FRAMEWORK DEFAULT (def 1) and is NOT fidelity evidence - v5r's own parameter for this is `leanJobsMaxParallel: 1` (vibe-math-v5r.js:1119), whose framework twin `vmu.math.leanJobsMaxParallel` already defaults to 1. It is kept because an integration pack should be readable and tunable. The real round-7 fidelity corrections are documented in defaults.js: `vmu.turn.selfCheck` true->false (v5r:1122 resourceSelfCheck false), `vmu.control.idleAfterMs: 120000` (v5r:1082 activityTimeoutMs), and the REMOVAL of `vmu.limits.maxLiveMembers: 3` (v5r:1130 maxLiveChildren 0 = no cap).

defaults._requireSettledRecords: PHASE 7 ROUND 3 (Lead ruling): FALSE, so a draft proposition can be written and promoted later by the verified track (the original workflow). This key is SNAPSHOTTED at kernel construction (kernel/records.js:189-221), so the VALUE layer is the only effective owner; the manifest line was removed to keep exactly one owner (a duplicate is refused as VMU_PACK_CONFLICT).
